name: no-mercy-lan
description: LAN-only real-time multiplayer card game inspired by UNO Show 'em No Mercy

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nomercy/shared" "npm run dev -w @nomercy/server" "npm run dev -w @nomercy/client"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nomercy/shared" "npm run dev:lan -w @nomercy/server" "npm run dev:lan -w @nomercy/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nomercy/shared && npm run build -w @nomercy/server && npm run build -w @nomercy/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @nomercy/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
